exposure: Previous lupus nephritis vs. no previous lupus nephritis
cohort: 60 pregnancies in 55 SLE patients at Hafez Hospital in Iran
finding: Pregnancies in most women with pre-existing SLE can now be managed with successful results, although the presence of previous lupus nephritis is still a major risk factor for adverse maternal outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean rate was about 66%, mostly related to fetal indications (50%).
